title: Next Permutation
description: Rearrange numbers into the lexicographically next greater permutation. If no such permutation exists, it must rearrange it to the lowest possible order (sorted in ascending order).

steps.note: Initialize 'n' as the length of the array.
Initialize 'k' to 'n - 2', starting from the second to last element.
Check while condition: k (1) >= 0 is true. nums[k] (3) >= nums[k+1] (2) is true. Both true, so decrement k.
Decrement k.
Check while condition: k (0) >= 0 is true. nums[k] (1) >= nums[k+1] (3) is false. Loop terminates.
Check if k is -1. k is 0, so condition is false. Skip full array reversal.
Initialize 'l' to 'n - 1', starting from the last element.
Check while condition: l (2) > k (0) is true. nums[l] (2) <= nums[k] (1) is false. Loop terminates.
Swap elements at index k (0) and l (2).
Executing swap function. Swapping nums[0] (1) and nums[2] (2).
Elements at index 0 and 2 are swapped.
Reverse the subarray from index k + 1 (1) to the end (n - 1 = 2).
Executing reverse function with start = 1 and end = 2.
Check while condition: start (1) < end (2) is true. Swap elements at start and end.
Executing swap function. Swapping nums[1] (3) and nums[2] (1).
Elements at index 1 and 2 are swapped.
Increment start.
Decrement end.
Check while condition: start (2) < end (1) is false. Loop terminates.
Next permutation found. Function completes.
